title: Verify wildfire fraction bounds and impact propagation
problem: The active public COD wildfire v1.1 file independently contains 99,939 duplicated fraction cells representing values up to four, while intensity has no duplicates. Original checked impact methods propagate out-of-range fractions. Population-weighted country comparisons and downstream consequences remain unverified.
humanitarian_relevance: Reliable climate-risk estimates may support adaptation appraisal. The cause is relevant; no decision improvement, avoided loss or population benefit from this contribution is established.

evidence.claim: The reporter describes country-level population-weighted differences and a 72-country sweep. Those impact estimates remain unverified; a separate public-file check now confirms the COD storage counts.

Pinned original sparse-storage unit test passes; eight synthetic original-method impact cases and shape rejection pass. Canonicalization preserves apparent values, out-of-range fractions propagate, and empty/all-zero fraction acts as identity. Damage ratios are a disclosed test double.

Checksum-verified active COD v1.1 file has 1,296,686 raw fraction ones, 1,191,978 canonical entries, 99,939 cells above one and maximum four. Intensity has no duplicates. Fraction sum/binary support is 1.087843903, a diagnostic arithmetic comparison rather than verified population-weighted impact.

code_surface: At develop dea46facc7856ed1c26adc1ee03e954c77d30c1b: climada/util/checker.py prune_csr_matrix; climada/hazard/base.py check_matrices and _get_fraction; climada/engine/impact_calc.py constructor and impact_matrix. Existing checker, hazard-base and impact-calculation test files inspected.
proposed_change: Mechanism and COD data counts are verified; agree a bounded diagnostics versus data-generation regression scope before patching. Preserve sparse addition semantics and obtain maintainer agreement before max/clipping or hazard regeneration.
tests: One unchanged original sparse-storage unit test, eight numeric original-method cases and shape-mismatch rejection pass. Public HDF5 sparse fields independently checked by row, then normalized using pinned original code on copies. No full framework suite, real damage-function/centroid assignment or population-weighted calculation.
environment: Audited CI/Conda/hooks/docs Dockerfile/config/API/HDF5 source and linked contribution guides. Original methods run with existing Python 3.13.7, NumPy 2.3.4, SciPy 1.16.2. A temporary system-site-packages venv adds only checksum-verified h5py 3.14.0 binary wheel with no dependencies/network during install; HDF5 1.14.6. Public CC BY 4.0 COD artifact downloaded and read-only checked. No CLIMADA install/import, service or full native environment.
maintainer: Verified Humanifest bot inquiry and independent results posted September 9 at #1312 comment 5599217450. No accepted scope, bot eligibility or reviewer commitment yet. Manual September 15 review; continue independent portfolio work meanwhile.
risks: Canonicalization preserves apparent sparse values; generic max/clipping may be mathematically wrong. Dataset-specific repair semantics, empty-fraction identity and existing arbitrary-valued fixtures need review. Full model behavior, population-weighted estimates and benefit remain unverified.
